name: SKYDIVE Off A TOWER! 🪂
desc:
🪂 How FAR can you SKYDIVE?

💡 How to play:
        💵 Skydive off tower to collect cash!
        🏢 Buy floors and build the tallest tower!
        🚀 Upgrade jetpacks to increase speed!
        😄 Teleport to friends’ towers and race!

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
